اصهاببت (form XI)

# اِصْهَابَبْتَ (iṣhābabta) /isˤ.haː.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْهَابَّ (iṣhābba)
# اِصْهَابَبْتِ (iṣhābabti) /isˤ.haː.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْهَابَّ (iṣhābba)
